incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark plume of smoke dominates the sky, with a house visible on the right side of the image, set against a line of trees and open field.

observations.description: A large, dense, dark grey smoke plume rising from behind a line of trees on the left, with lighter smoke visible closer to the house on the right.
A single house is visible on the right side of the image, with no visible damage or signs of fire on its exterior.
A line of dark trees runs horizontally across the lower part of the image, with some scattered individual trees.
A house with a gabled roof and visible windows, situated near a line of trees and open field.
The ground appears to be a field, possibly agricultural, with no visible vehicles or people.

inconsistencies: The report mentions smoke rising behind a farm, but the image shows smoke rising from a line of trees on the left, not a farm structure. The house is on the right, not directly behind the smoke as described.
not_determinable: The cause of the smoke (wildfire or otherwise)
The proximity of the smoke to the house (distance)
Whether the house is at risk or if it is already damaged
The scale of the fire or extent of the smoke plume
